# GateCtr

> GateCtr is an LLM gateway that sits between your app and any LLM provider. One endpoint swap gives you cost control, smart routing, prompt compression, and real-time analytics.

GateCtr provides: -40% token costs via Context Optimizer, hard budget caps via Budget Firewall, automatic model selection via Model Router, real-time analytics, webhooks, and RBAC.

Base API URL: https://api.gatectr.com/v1
Dashboard: https://app.gatectr.com
Authentication: Bearer token — header `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/intro): Overview of GateCtr features and capabilities
- [Quickstart](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/getting-started/quickstart): Up and running in 5 minutes — install SDK, get API key, make first request
- [Authentication](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/getting-started/authentication): How to authenticate with the GateCtr API
- [First Request](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/getting-started/first-request): Step-by-step guide to your first LLM request through GateCtr

## API Reference

- [POST /v1/complete](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/api-reference/complete): Send text completion requests through the gateway — supports streaming, optimization, routing, and budget enforcement
- [POST /v1/chat](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/api-reference/chat): Chat completions endpoint — OpenAI-compatible
- [GET /v1/usage](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/api-reference/usage): Retrieve token usage and cost data for a project

## Features

- [Context Optimizer](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/features/context-optimizer): Automatically compresses prompts by up to 40% — reduces token costs while preserving output quality
- [Budget Firewall](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/features/budget-firewall): Hard token and cost caps per project — blocks requests the moment a limit is hit, no surprise invoices
- [Model Router](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/features/model-router): Automatically selects the best and cheapest LLM for each request based on task complexity and pricing
- [Analytics](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/features/analytics): Real-time token usage, cost tracking, and request logs per project
- [Webhooks](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/features/webhooks): Push budget alerts and events to Slack, Teams, or any URL

## SDKs

- [Node.js SDK](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/sdks/node): `npm install @gatectr/sdk` — TypeScript/JavaScript client
- [Python SDK](https://docs.gatectr.com/docs/sdks/python): `pip install gatectr-sdk` — async Python client
